messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> SEV:P1 GPU memory pressure spike on pool-gpu-eu-west-3. 42% of requests returning CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL. node-group: pool-gpu-eu-west-3, affected nodes: gpu-7,gpu-9,gpu-11. autoscaler unable to place new pods.

incident-bot: sample log dump:
```
2026-03-14T10:17:12Z model-server[pid=4231]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (requested 512MB)
2026-03-14T10:17:12Z kvcache[pid=5122]: kvcache_put failed: cuda error 2
2026-03-14T10:17:13Z proxy[pid=3001]: 503 upstream error -> backend gpu-7 (nv-rtx)
```

pagerduty: Pager duty incident #PD-8342 triggered, escalation policy: oncall-week, initial page sent.

alice: acked PD-8342. I'm on it. quick note: traffic to this pool is 3x normal due to a retried job from a partner region. Could be flood.

ben: copying logs - thanks. is this causing user-facing errors? any customer tickets?

alice: yes, error rate up. External: ~4% of generation requests returning 503s, internal retry loop causing extra load. Impact: hosted API customers behind routing rule 'region-eu' hit this. Not global.

carla: I'm going to drain gpu-11 and kick its pods to another pool (non-prod spare). planning to set `max_inflight` to 32 for that pool to slow throughput while freeing memory.

mike: propose immediate mitigation: 1) throttle incoming to pool-gpu-eu-west-3 by 50% at the edge (rate-limit header override). 2) trigger autoscale override to add 2 spare nodes (if capacity available). 3) enable model fallback to quantized-8 on overflow.

alice: doing 1) and 2) now. Edge rule patch applied (ingress-rule id: ir-772). throttling seen in metrics. scaling request to infra submitted.

incident-bot: autoscaler response: unable to allocate new baremetal GPUs in region eu-west-3 within threshold (quota hit).

ben: if autoscale can't add nodes, need to reduce memory pressure on existing nodes. carla, proceed with draining. can we evict low-priority pods and move some canaries to dedicated-cpu pool?

carla: evicting noncritical pods on gpu-11 now. command: `kubectl drain gpu-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`

carla: eviction logs: pod model-alpha-rt replaced on cpu-dedicated-2, pod session-cache recreated on gpu-3 (less loaded). freeing ~12GB.

zoe: heads-up — disabling kvcache prefix caching for pool-gpu-eu-west-3 temporarily to cut memory overhead. patch applied via feature-flag: `kvcache.prefix.enabled=false` for that pool. expect higher latency for some requests but reduces memory by ~20% per node.

mike: set model fallback policy for the pool: fallback -> `gptx-quant8` on cuda_alloc_fail. config pushed.

alice: after throttling + evictions + kvcache off, OOMs have dropped to intermittent. error rate from 4% -> 0.8% in last 5m. still seeing occasional `cudaMalloc` errors on gpu-7.

ben: good progress. can we enable temporary automatic retries with exponential backoff on client side? risk: increases load. prefer server-side 429 with Retry-After to force backoff.

alice: switching to 429 responses for over-limit now. ingress returns 429 with Retry-After=10 when pool saturated.

pagerduty: PD-8342 acknowledged by alice at 2032101120.

mike: recommend timeline: continue mitigation for 30m, monitor error rate and latency. if error rate <1% and autoscaler still can't add nodes, pull a long-term plan: investigate partner retried job and patch to cap retries.

carla: raising a ticket to infra for quota bump in eu-west-3 and follow-up on kvcache memory optimizations. ticket INFRA-1198 created.

zoe: creating post-incident eval checklist: capture promptset failures, compare quant8 vs baseline quality, and check rollback plan for kvcache flag.

alice: handing off to ben for overnight watch. I'll finish notes in the incident doc and tag SRE rotations. ben, you're up as primary oncall for next 6h.

ben: ack — taking over. action items assigned: monitor PD, watch error rate, coordinate with infra on quota ticket, validate fallback quality.

incident-bot: PD-8342 updated: status -> acknowledged; responders: alice, ben. next escalation in 15m if no resolution.

alice: final note: customers impacted list (tracked): cust-Delta, cust-BlueApp, cust-SeqLabs — outreach queued. status page draft at /status/incidents/PD-8342-draft.

ben: will keep thread updated. switching channel to #eng-oncall (call if escalation). :phone:
